heading: Inside and out
intro: Sit out on the gravel patio with the yellow and blue bistro chairs and Lavazza umbrellas, or stay in by the green wall. Follow the “Patio this way” sign by the front door.

Croissants, pain au chocolat and ube financiers

The green wall, the sofa and the poufs
